Marvel Sets 2028 Release for Ryan Gosling's 'Ghost Rider'

Marvel has officially announced that Ryan Gosling's 'Ghost Rider' film is scheduled for a Summer 2028 release. The movie will be positioned between other Marvel Cinematic Universe projects, specifically 'X-Men' and 'Black Panther 3'. This announcement provides a concrete release date for the anticipated film.
